subject: Security evidence escort & control walkthrough for Acme Payments RFP
messages:
From: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acmepayments.com>
To: logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Cc: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmepayments.com>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP - Security evidence & walkthrough request

Hi Logan,

Thanks for the quick intro call earlier — Acme Payments is moving your RFP through the security review and we need a compact evidence package plus a short technical walkthrough. Items we need, roughly prioritized:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent)
- ISO 27001 certificate + scope
- Control mapping showing where each SIG control is implemented (mapping to our SIG questionnaire IDs)
- Sample logs (redacted) demonstrating retention and access controls (for S3 & syslog)
- KMS / key management description and attestations (rotation policy, HSM usage)
- Data residency and backup policy details

Can you provide an index of artifacts and a 30–45 minute walkthrough with a member of the security/infra team this week? We have procurement loops that need a Docusign link around the contract but that can follow the security sign-off.

Attachments: Acme_Security_RFP_2028.pdf (RFP extract)

Best,
Megan Liu
Security Lead, Acme Payments
megan.liu@acmepayments.com
phone: +1 415-555-0198

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acmepayments.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 10:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP - Security evidence & walkthrough request

Megan — thanks, this is clear.

Plan: I attached a control-evidence-index.xlsx that maps required artifacts to SIG / SOC2 / ISO controls and lists owners. We can do a 30-minute technical walkthrough Thursday 2028-06-21 at 10:00 AM PT or Friday 2028-06-22 at 09:00 AM PT — which works for your team?

What I will attach now:
- control-evidence-index.xlsx (artifact index & owners)
- SOC2_Type2_Report_2027.pdf (redacted, distribution copy)
- demo-runbook.md (short runbook showing where to find logs and how to reproduce a sample request)

Internal note to CCs: Kim and Neha — please review the index and confirm owners for KMS proof, logs, and ISO scope. I’ll pull the initial shared Drive folder and give Acme view access once we have the KMS and log samples ready.

We’ll keep commercially-sensitive items out of the shared folder until procurement confirms an NDA — we can provide redacted artifacts in the folder for security review.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
logan.wright@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: control-evidence-index.xlsx; SOC2_Type2_Report_2027.pdf; demo-runbook.md

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP - Security evidence & walkthrough request (internal)

Thanks Logan — quick task list so we can hit the deadlines:

- Neha: collect KMS artifacts: KMS architecture diagram, key rotation policy excerpt, HSM attestation statement; target upload to shared Drive by EOD Thu.
- Tessa: prepare redacted log bundle (app access logs + control plane audit) and retention policy excerpt; include a readme with sample grep commands to reproduce the filtering. Target Fri morning.
- Kimberly: confirm ISO certificate image and scope statement (I have the cert from 2026 but need to verify scope includes hosted inference service).
- Logan: confirm walkthrough slot with Acme and provide agenda (30 min: 10 min architecture, 10 min controls mapping, 10 min Q&A).

I’ll draft the artifact naming convention: ACME_RFP_2028/{control-id}/{artifact-name}_v1.redacted.

Kim
Director, Trust & Security Operations
Attachment: none

From: Tom Reyes <tom.reyes@acmepayments.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Megan Liu <megan.liu@acmepayments.com>, procurement@acmepayments.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 08:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP - Security evidence & walkthrough request

Logan — Thursday 10:00 AM PT works. Megan and I are looping in procurement for next steps; procurement asked for the commercial contact to receive the DocuSign envelope. Can you please route the DocuSign to contracts@redwoodinference.com (cc: me) once we have a final boilerplate?

Also attached is our SIG_Questionnaire_Partial.xlsx where we filled the first pass. If you can mark the mapping in the control index (col named "ACME_SIG_ID"), that will speed review.

DocuSign link (procurement): https://app.docusign.com/Envelopes/12345ABCDE

Thanks,
Tom Reyes
Sr. Manager, Procurement — Acme Payments
Attachment: SIG_Questionnaire_Partial.xlsx

From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Cc: kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 09:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP - Security evidence & walkthrough request — action items

Forwarding Acme thread with procurement link.

Neha / Tessa — please prioritize the following and upload to the shared Drive folder I will create (see link below):

- KMS artifacts (Neha) — include rotation policy excerpt and a short "how to verify" checklist for auditors.
- Logs (Tessa) — produce a 7-day sample bundle with redactions and a README explaining redaction approach.
- Control mapping (Neha + Kim) — populate ACME_SIG_ID column in control-evidence-index.xlsx to match the attached SIG_Questionnaire_Partial.xlsx.

I will create the Drive folder and grant Megan & Tom view access after the artifacts are uploaded. Walkthrough is 2028-06-21 10:00 AM PT (Zoom dial-in will be shared by Acme).

Shared Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qA_example_shared_folder

Logan

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwoodinference.com>, kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com, tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 22 Jun 2028 15:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP - Security evidence & walkthrough request — action items

Quick status update ahead of the walkthrough:

- Uploaded: ACME_RFP_2028/06_kms/Key_Management_Diagram_v1.redacted.pdf, Key_Rotation_Policy_excerpt_v1.txt (shared link in folder).
- Uploaded: ACME_RFP_2028/07_logs/redacted_app_logs_7d.tar.gz (README included).
- Updated control-evidence-index.xlsx with ACME_SIG_ID mapping for 42 controls — see tab "ACME_Mapping".
- ISO27001_Certificate_2026.png uploaded; scope note included (we exclude experimental sandbox clusters).

All items above are redacted where needed and labeled per Kim's naming convention. I also added a short artifact index (artifact_index.md) describing what is redacted and why.

We are ready for the walkthrough. If procurement needs an NDA before we increment access beyond the redacted set, let me know and I will hold the unredacted artifacts.

Neha Kapoor
Senior Manager, Cloud Security Engineering
Attachment: none
